description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Send an HTTP request (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD) through egress and return status_code, response headers, and body as text or base64 (`binary: true`). `max_bytes` caps the stored body; `follow_redirects` (default true) and `timeout_s` (95 s ceiling) apply to the full redirect chain. Use `json_body` for JSON POST/PUT payloads; use `body` for raw bytes or strings. Prefer readfetch_text for readable HTML articles; readfetch_pdf to extract PDF text (not raw bytes alone). POST/PUT/DELETE can change remote state despite readOnlyHint.

binary.description: When true, return body as base64 instead of UTF-8 text.
binary.title: Binary

body.description: Raw request body string for POST/PUT/PATCH (mutually exclusive with json_body).
body.title: Body

headers.description: Optional request headers, e.g. Authorization or Accept.
headers.title: Headers

json_body.description: JSON object serialized as the request body (Content-Type application/json).
json_body.title: Json Body

max_bytes.description: Stop reading and truncate once the response body exceeds this size (bytes).
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

timeout_s.description: Total budget for the whole call in seconds, redirect hops included.
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

name: readfetch_fetch
